limits: Metadata availability does not establish on-device collection permissions or counter accuracy
Cumulative counters and interval averages do not uniquely reconstruct per-cycle bank read enables
A/B wavefront counts are not automatically useful bytes; access size, bank masks and wavefront semantics need calibration
Requests and served traffic must be separated; existing ports can throttle demand into stalls
TMEM C/D counter meanings do not reveal proprietary internal SRAM bank layout
Standard LSU shared-load counters are not substitutes for the dedicated TC path counters
